messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — Orion Health legal is blocking the POC without SOC 2 artifacts + a signed NDA. They specifically asked for the SOC 2 report and temporary access to a curated evidence bundle for a 2-week evaluation. Meeting with them tomorrow 2pm PT. Can we expedite? @li @sarah :pray:

 daniel: I can run the POC side. Clarify: do they need the full report PDF or just controls matrix + sample evidence? Also any redaction rules?

 maya: Quote from them — "SOC 2 report and ability to inspect relevant evidence (logs/configs) under NDA; otherwise we can't proceed with HI data for the trial." They asked for the report + some logs.

 li: We do have a SOC 2 Type II for the most recent period. We can provide: the report PDF (redacted for auditor ops notes), a controls matrix, and a curated evidence bundle in S3. Requirements:
- NDA signed first
- presigned S3 URLs with expiry (we prefer 7 days)
- explicit file list (we curate to avoid PII/IP leaks)
I'll prepare a recommended file list. @sarah any legal constraints? :mag_right:

 sarah: We can proceed but legal wants these protections in the NDA:
1) Evidence access scoped to specific S3 prefixes (explicit list)
2) Presigned URLs expire in 7 days and are single-use where possible
3) No redistribution; no retention beyond the POC (delete within 30 days)
4) No auditor-style attestation in the NDA (we'll provide an "operational attestation" instead)
I'll prepare a lean NDA template and an "evidence access" clause id S3-EVID-2026.

 maya: Customer asked for a short "bridge statement" while they run vendor review. Legal: are we comfortable with an ops attestation instead of a formal bridge letter?

 sarah: Yes — we will not issue a legal bridge letter. We can provide an "operational attestation" that says: "Redwood Inference attests that as of <date> Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II controls for security and availability; the full report is available to authorized parties under NDA." This is a descriptive statement, not a new auditor opinion. That should satisfy most vendor risk teams.

 daniel: For the POC bundle I'll assemble: config snapshots, service access logs (redacted), monitoring screenshots, and a README + md5 manifest. I'll strip IPs and any customer PII. Plan to deliver presigned URLs (7d expiry) to the signed parties. ETA: 24–36h once legal OKs NDA language.

 li: Note from infra/security: redact internal IPs & anonymize user IDs from application logs. Avoid sharing KV cache dumps. I'll produce the curated file list before EOD.

 maya: Customer expected turnaround <48h. I'll propose this workflow to them: sign NDA via DocuSign, we send ops attestation + presigned S3 bundle (7d), then one follow-up Q&A. Sounds good? :thumbsup:

 sarah: I'll upload the NDA template to DocuSign and include S3-EVID-2026. Will add a clause limiting evidence use to evaluation and deletion within 30 days.

 deploy-bot: presigned-url-generator v1.4 queued (no action until bundle ready).

 maya: Thanks team — I'll confirm with the customer and post the DocuSign link once Sarah uploads. @daniel please ping me when the bundle is staged so we can trigger the presigned-url job.

 daniel: Will do. Putting a note on my calendar to finish the bundle tonight.

 maya: Perfect — I’ll close the loop after the DocuSign send.
